task.description:
Implement API-12 (Health endpoints) according to src/design/api-health.md.

Required outcomes:
- Add unauthenticated GET /health/live endpoint that returns HTTP 200 with {"status":"ok"} while process is running
- Add unauthenticated GET /health/ready endpoint that returns HTTP 200 with {"status":"ok","db_latency_ms":N} only when DB connectivity and required subsystems are ready
- /health/ready MUST call DB-04 (Pool.healthCheck) to verify connectivity
- On readiness failure, return HTTP 503 with structured response identifying failing subsystem (including pool exhausted handling)
- Ensure health endpoints remain unauthenticated while still flowing through API-09 trace assignment
- Keep handler execution bounded to satisfy the <1s API-12 response target

Validation required in this handoff:
- zig build
- zig build test
- Confirm /health/live and /health/ready routes are public and reachable through the API router

Update this handoff result with all touched artifacts and any issues.
acceptance_criteria: GET /health/live exists and returns HTTP 200 with status ok
GET /health/ready uses DB-04 health check and returns db_latency_ms on readiness success
Readiness failures return HTTP 503 with failing subsystem details
Health endpoints do not require authentication

result.summary: Implemented API-12 health endpoints with unauthenticated /health/live and /health/ready handlers, DB-04-backed readiness checks, structured 503 degraded responses (including pool exhausted mapping), and OpenAPI route registration confirming public reachability.
